paite: Nipi la a vuk bang leh pawltak lai a vuah bang in, zahtakhuaina mihai a ding in akilawm kei hi.
Kawlgit avakvaih bang in, phialphiah alen lai bang in, huchi mah bang in hamsia bulbal nei lou atangtung kei hi.
Zepna sakol a ding, kamkaihna sabiltung a ding, huan chiang mihaite nungzang a ding ahi.
Mihai ahaina dungzui in dawng ke'n, huchi lou in zaw nang leng amah na bang kha ding.
Mihai ahaina bang in dawng in, ama kideihna ah apilsak kha ding hi.
Kuapeuh mihai khut a thukhak in amah khete atankhia a, siatna ding adawn hi.
Khebai khete a kikhai nelnel; huai bangmah in mihaite kam sung a gentehna ahi.
Mihai kiang a zahna piak zaw suanglotna khau a suang gakkhawm bang ahi.
Zukham hat khut a loulingnei bang in, huai bangmah in mihaite kam sung a gentehna ahi.
Mihai leh mivialvak guaimi, thalkap siam midang liamsak zel mi bang ahi.
Ui ama luak lam a kik nawn bang in, huai bangmah in ahaina sunzom mihai ahi.
Ama kideihna a pil mi na mu hia? Amah a pan sang in mihai a kipan lametna a-om zaw hi.
Thadah in, "Lampi ah humpinelkai a-om; kongzing ah humpinelkai a- om," achi hi.
Kongkhak a kopza ah akihei zel bang in, alupna tung ah thadahna a-om hi.
Thadah in kuang sung ah akhut athun a; akam atun ngap nawn kei hi.
Thadah ama kideihna ah asan pe thei ding mi sagih sang in pil akisa zaw hi.
Kuapeuh paisuak a, amah a hilou kinakna a kihihbuai, ui abil a man bang ahi.
Mihai in mei-ekte, thal leh sihna viallot bang in;
mi invengte khem a, chiamnui ka hi kei a hia? chi toh akibang hi.
Sing taksap ziak in mei amit a; huan huauhatmi omlouhna ah, kinakna abei hi.
Suangkuangtheite meisumsa a ding bang in leh sing mei a ding bang in; kinak hatmi kilanna uangsak ahi.
Huauhatmi thute an limtak bang ahi, huan gilpi sungnungpen ah atumsuk hi.
Leibel limlang tui a luan bang in, lungtang gilou muk azol in anal hi!
Mihuauhat in amuk in athehdalh a, alungtang in khemna apai.
Kilawmna thu agen chiang in, amah um ke'n; alungtang ah lah kihhuai sagih a-om ngal a.
Ahuatna khemna in kituam mahleh, khawmpite ma ah tangpi muh in agitlouhna etsak ahi ding hi.
Kuapeuh khuk tou huai ah ake ding; huan kuapeuh suang khuk, amah tung ah hong kileh ding hi.
Lei zuauthei in ahihliamsate amudah a, maitangphat hat kam in siatna abawl hi.
